assertions.description: setMicrophoneActive(false) returns a Promise (the Chrome 159 spec alignment; the legacy behaviour returned undefined).
assertions.test: (()=>{const ms=navigator.mediaSession;if(!ms||typeof ms.setMicrophoneActive!=='function')return false;const r=ms.setMicrophoneActive(false);const ok=r instanceof Promise;if(ok)r.catch(()=>{});return ok;})()
(()=>{const ms=navigator.mediaSession;if(!ms||typeof ms.setCameraActive!=='function')return false;const r=ms.setCameraActive(false);const ok=r instanceof Promise;if(ok)r.catch(()=>{});return ok;})()

assertions.description: In a fully active document the returned promise resolves with undefined for both setters.
assertions.test: (async()=>{const ms=navigator.mediaSession;if(!ms||typeof ms.setMicrophoneActive!=='function'||typeof ms.setCameraActive!=='function')return false;const a=ms.setMicrophoneActive(false);const b=ms.setCameraActive(false);if(!(a instanceof Promise)||!(b instanceof Promise))return false;const va=await a;const vb=await b;return va===undefined&&vb===undefined;})()

assertions.description: Called on the mediaSession of a document that is not fully active (a detached same-origin iframe), the returned promise rejects with an InvalidStateError DOMException.
assertions.test: (async()=>{const f=document.createElement('iframe');f.src='about:blank';document.body.append(f);await new Promise((r)=>{f.addEventListener('load',r,{once:true});setTimeout(r,500);});const s=f.contentWindow.navigator.mediaSession;f.remove();if(!s||typeof s.setMicrophoneActive!=='function')return false;let r;try{r=s.setMicrophoneActive(true);}catch(e){return false;}if(!r||typeof r.then!=='function')return false;try{await r;return false;}catch(e){return e&&e.name==='InvalidStateError';}})()
